aarti.pad1: Father, mother, helper, master and friend: you alone are our one Lord. Those who have no other support, you alone are their keeper. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: You always give happiness in every way; you are the destroyer of sorrow and vice. You sustain the whole world, holding exceeding compassion in your heart. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: We forget you, but you do not let us slip from your mind. There is no end to your kindnesses, which you spread out moment by moment. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Your glory is great, O Mahārāja; rarely found by the likes of me, you belong to the wise. You are the home of blessed peace, a treasure-house of love, the light in the temple of the mind. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: You are the life of this life, the beloved of these breaths of life. Having found a Lord like you, O Hari, on whom else should Pratāpa now depend? ॥5॥
